source.boundary: Synthetic Preview browser capture only. Existing required registry, fixture, review, quality and release gates remain required. A capture or candidate attestation does not establish receiving acceptance.
source.verifiedSourceBoundary: Recorded checkout head/tree and all four source capture contracts independently match immutable Git content.

coverage.note: Every new PNG individually opened with view_image. Reuse admitted only after retained PNG bytes, original independent review references and hashes were verified.

verdict: No blocking visible regression found in supplied static Header/A2 materiality states
visibleChanges: Simplified full-shell top chrome removes duplicated search/bell controls while desktop sidebar search remains visible.
Files and one-Project Analytics expose a closed Share control at every supplied viewport; larger captures show the member avatar.
Project overview, General settings, Chat preview, concept listing, Wedding hub and task drawer remain legible in the newly inspected larger views.
nonBlockingObservations: Inherited mobile Tasks-loading PNG is664px wide against nominal390px viewport and matches prior reviewed bytes; no zero-overflow claim is issued.
Mobile Share remains visible while the member avatar is omitted in the narrow header; no blocked control or overlap was visible.
limitations: Review covers Header/A2 and transitive initial-state image materiality only, not any authored Auth helper/code or behavior. The Auth capture bundle was not reviewed.
Settings shows General, not Security/provider/phone UI. No provider enablement, sign-in behavior, phone activation or Auth release acceptance is inferred.
Share/member controls are closed. No popup interaction, copying, invite, audience change or authenticated continuity is certified by these stills.
The source captures are synthetic preview/deterministic fixtures, not authenticated production, live data or founder acceptance.
Files remains sample/demo data; Welcome is its known unavailable fallback; upload target shows an affordance, not completed provider upload.
Completion/confetti, collapse/reorder, saved views, retries, Chat sends and open-Chat toast correction require separate interaction evidence.
No Ping history GET, Apply/Undo, model call, Drive/Blob request or provider behavior was performed or inferred.
Cloud browser outcomes are producer evidence inspected against raw report/attestation, not independently replayed. No build/provider/live test was run.
